entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Lucius Aemilius Barbula was a patrician Roman consul in 281 BC. His colleague was Quintus Marcius Philippus. During his consulship he was given a command against the Samnites but spent most of the year fighting the Tarentines in the then-incipient Pyrrhic War.
